keffstation.title: KeffStation — platform for independent web applications
keffstation.description: KeffStation is a showcase that brings together several independent web applications (PWA). Each space has its own purpose and its own services. They do not form a single store and do not all offer the same things.

kifftech.name: KiffTech
kifftech.title: KiffTech — connected objects and high-tech gadgets
kifftech.description: KiffTech is a showcase dedicated to connected objects, electronic gadgets and high-tech accessories. You will find a product catalog, detailed datasheets and links to official stores.
kifftech.historique: History of everything paid (products, cart, register).
kifftech.aucun_paiement: No paid order yet. Payments appear here after PayPal validation.

kifftech.délai_livraison: Estimated delivery time is 1 week to 5 weeks depending on the product and package volume. If the announced delivery time is exceeded, a partial refund is applied.
kifftech.prix_officiels: Manufacturer prices and occasional promotions are easily found in many online stores. At KiffTech, we do not seek to align with these prices visible everywhere.
kifftech.délais_estimation: Delivery times are estimates, not contractual commitments.

kifftech.prix_promo: KiffTech Promo Price: −20% from 10 items at checkout (group purchase) • Free shipping for KiffTech Club subscribers
kifftech.credits_intro: The 175 catalog visuals come from Wikimedia Commons. They are used under the license indicated for each file (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA or public domain): commercial use authorized with attribution; CC BY-SA files additionally require share-alike. Images have been resized (500 px) for display. Each datasheet links to its source page to identify the author and exact license.

viartificial-labs.name: ViArtificial Labs
viartificial-labs.title: ViArtificial Labs — AI engines and conversation
viartificial-labs.description: ViArtificial Labs offers tools around artificial intelligence: conversation engines, assistants and NLP/LLM experiments running partly locally.

critiques-services.name: Critiques-Services
critiques-services.title: Critiques-Services — service reviews and criticism
critiques-services.description: Critiques-Services is a space dedicated to reviews and criticism of online services and digital tools. It is an information hub, not a store.

tricktrocjob.name: Tricktrocjob
tricktrocjob.title: Tricktrocjob — utilities and technical tools
tricktrocjob.description: Tricktrocjob brings together utilities, scripts and technical tools for troubleshooting and productivity.

videogames.name: Videogames
videogames.title: Videogames — games and emulation
videogames.description: Videogames offers games, emulation and content around retrogaming and gaming.

cos-editor.title: COS Editor — Analysis, Preview and Tutorials
